note: Run by the Chehaw Park Authority (City of Albany, Dougherty and Lee Counties). Campground among tall pines in an 800-acre park with a zoo; group shelter, camper cabins. --Claude
summary: Read chehaw.org's camping page and the FareHarbor booking pages: confirmed $25 standard / $33 full hookup (2027 too) and the $15 reservation fee; set electric 50 (FareHarbor '50/30/20 Amp'), sites 40, booking via FareHarbor (operator) with URL and check-in rules. Note cleaned. Pin is on the zoo car park, ~0.5 km from the campground.
flags: Pin: stored 31.6285,-84.1310 sits on the zoo/park car park; the campground loops are about 500 m SSW, around 31.6243,-84.1331 (Google's 'Chehaw Campground' pin is 31.625019,-84.1338535). Suggest moving the pin there.

Park admission: Chehaw sells 'Park Admission Only' ($3.50 adult, $2 child/senior/military; FareHarbor item 708649), but neither the camping page nor the RV booking items say whether campers pay it, so fees.entrance is left unset.
